name: layout/expandable-card
title: Expandable card
description: A card that opens into its details in place.

files.content:
export { ExpandableCard } from './ExpandableCard';
export type { ExpandableCardProps } from './ExpandableCard';

notes: A disclosure: the title is a button inside a heading, with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
Focus does not move when the card opens or closes.
Hidden details are removed from the page, so they are not read or reached while closed.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The card opens and closes at once, without the spring or the fade.
